About SA Traders

SA Traders supplies Golden Food Industry products to retailers, shopkeepers and wholesale buyers. Our range covers pan masala, supari, nimko and crunchy snacks.

We keep things simple: honest rates, products as described, and quick answers when you message us.

Common Questions

Do you sell to individual customers?

We mainly supply shopkeepers, retailers and wholesale buyers. Send an enquiry and we will tell you what is possible.

Why are rates not shown on the website?

Prices change with stock and quantity. Message us and you get today's exact rate.

Is there a minimum order?

It depends on the product. Mention your quantity in the enquiry and we will confirm.

Which cities do you supply?

Write your city in the message and we will confirm delivery for your area.

Let's do business

Need wholesale rates or have a question about a product? Fill in the form and it opens in WhatsApp with your details ready to send.
